prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / production game texture.
Create ONE square 2048x2048-style BASE COLOR MATERIAL ATLAS for the rusty moss-covered yellow industrial robot concepts we have been making. This is an actual UV texture source, NOT a robot picture, NOT a presentation board.
Exactly four equal seamless material quadrants arranged in a 2x2 grid with NO gutters, NO borders, NO labels:
TOP LEFT: chipped faded ochre-yellow industrial paint, about 55 percent surviving yellow paint, dark iron scratches, 30 percent reddish dark rust, fine worn edges, sparse lichen specks.
TOP RIGHT: almost black graphite mechanical metal with dark brown oxidation and subtle abrasion, no yellow paint, no moss.
BOTTOM LEFT: coarse pitted reddish-brown rusted steel with some exposed desaturated silver steel, no paint.
BOTTOM RIGHT: dense natural dark olive-green moss carpet with small brighter fern-green tips and tiny brown patches, granular organic surface, no large grass blades.
Every quadrant is evenly lit, orthographic flat material scan under diffuse neutral white light, no cast shadows, no directional perspective, no highlights, no depicted geometry, no plates/panel lines/bolts, no large isolated objects. Consistent fine material detail; designed to wrap irregular hard-surface mesh shapes. Do not turn into a collage of robot parts. Square flat atlas only.
